pages.text: $(thing)Aquamirae$() adds a frozen ocean region called the $(thing)Ice Maze$(): pirate ships and outposts, shelters, and shipwrecks locked in ice, with their own creatures. Fragmentum, a library mod, and GeckoLib sit underneath it.

The Ice Maze has three bosses. The $(item)Shell Horn$() summons the Ghost of Captain Cornelia near water in the Ice Maze. The Maze Mother lives deeper in. The Shipbreaker is a leviathan; its Ship Graveyard Echo leaves a trace that the Echo Compass can follow.

pages.title: Shell Horn
pages.text: Found in frozen pirate ships. Summons Captain Cornelia when used near water in the Ice Maze.

pages.title: Frozen Key
pages.text: Dropped by Cornelia. Opens a hidden chest in the depths of the Ice Maze.

pages.title: Tidepiercer
pages.text: Cornelia's weapon, looted from her after the fight.

pages.title: Echo Compass
pages.text: Points toward the nearest Ship Graveyard Echo.

$(thing)Salvager armor$() supplies air underwater and keeps you from freezing in the Ice Maze. Two upgrade templates make better armor: the Terrible template upgrades Iron armor with a Fin, and the Abyssal template upgrades Diamond armor with Abyssal Amethyst.

pages.title: Rune of the Storm
pages.text: Found buried in the Ice Maze. Attach at a smithing table: +40% damage, or -10% damage taken, in cold biomes.

Its fish and drops feed straight into cooking: Spinefish, Esca, Jellyfish Jelly and Sea Stew all exist, and fit in with $(l:food/farmers_delight)Farmer's Delight$(/l) style meals. For a way to get there, see $(l:ocean/submarines)Submarines$(/l). More boss info: $(l:exploration/bosses)Bosses$(/l).
